sequential_dependency.intermediate: The reference length, clipped normalized cell sets, and per-line actual addition-plus-deletion counts.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the common endpoint baseline and spatially middle line, read its length, and normalize every line with canvas clipping.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Highlight the normalized line with the unique largest actual edit count.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The number of realizable changes depends on inferred length, endpoint direction and boundary clipping. Original length or requested growth can select a different line.

parametric_work.summary: Middle-line normalization, then largest actual boundary-aware edit. Supports 2..6 demonstrations and independent 1..4 privately shuffled query prefixes; minimum two-demo lesson rejects finite executable rivals.
